examples.name: basic
examples.content:
# Basic service deployment.
#
# Demonstrates: single service, multiple instances, exposed port, resource constraints.
# Run with:  cca apply examples/basic.ccattler
#            cca run examples/basic.ccattler        (real OS processes)
#            cca demo                                (built-in simulated version)
#
# Expected: 3 instances of web running, each consuming 500m CPU and 512Mi memory.

service web {
    image nginx:1.28
    instances 3
    expose 8080
    resources {
        cpu 500m
        memory 512Mi
    }
}

examples.name: distributed
examples.content:
# Distributed deployment across multiple nodes.
#
# Demonstrates: instance spread across nodes, resource-aware scheduling,
#               failure recovery when a node dies.
# Run with:  cca apply examples/distributed.ccattler   (3 simulated nodes)
#            cca demo-distributed                        (built-in with node kill)
#
# Expected: 6 instances spread evenly (2 per node on a 3-node cluster).
#           If a node dies, its instances reschedule to surviving nodes.

service web {
    image nginx:1.28
    instances 6
    expose 8080
    resources {
        cpu 500m
        memory 512Mi
    }
}

examples.name: networking
examples.description: Networking: VIPs, DNS, and load balancing.
examples.content:
# Networking: VIPs, DNS, and load balancing.
#
# Demonstrates: per-instance IP allocation from node subnets, service VIPs,
#               DNS resolution (service-name.ccattler.local), round-robin LB.
# Run with:  cca demo-network   (built-in with load balancing demo)
#
# Expected: Each instance gets a unique IP from its node's 10.100.x.0/24 subnet.
#           Each service gets a VIP from the 10.200.0.0/24 pool.
#           DNS resolves "web" and "api" to their VIPs.
#           Traffic to a service balances across its instances.

service web {
    image nginx:1.28
    instances 4
    expose 8080
    resources {
        cpu 500m
        memory 512Mi
    }
}

service api {
    image myapp:latest
    instances 2
    expose 3000
    resources {
        cpu 250m
        memory 256Mi
    }
}
